hooks.command: branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$branch" ] && [ "$branch" != "main" ] && ahead=$(git rev-list --count main.."$branch" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) && [ "$ahead" -gt 0 ] && git checkout main && git merge --no-ff "$branch" -m "Merge $branch into main" && git push origin main && git checkout "$branch" || true
